_note: Tuning knobs for the pane-kind chips. preview.html and the (not yet written)
generator both read this file, so what you see in the preview is what ships.
Geometry lives in the .svg files; nothing here is baked into the paths.
fill    fraction of the chip box the mark's ink occupies. Per-kind because
equal measured size does not read as equal optical size: the knot's
heavy perimeter looks larger than the starburst at the same value.
dilate  re-strokes a filled path in its own color to fatten thin features.
The starburst's spokes taper to points and wash out at chip size.
Units are a 24-unit box for every mark regardless of its own
viewBox, so the number stays comparable across icons.
Past ~0.9 the starburst's hub fills in solid.
Ignored for stroked marks -- tune terminal.svg's stroke-width.
colors  8-digit #RRGGBBAA hex. bg is the chip, fg is the mark.
exploreMark
The mark color for preview.html's tinted and bare rows. Nothing
ships reads it: the manifest declares one treatment, and these
exist so a change to it can be judged by eye first. The value is
the brand color where the chip is saturated, and a legible
neutral where it is not. 6-digit hex, not 8: the tinted row
builds its background by appending an alpha to this string.
A dark appearance needs its own value whenever the brand color
is too dark to read as a bare mark on the dark row.
